title: Remove NeedsReauth — Dead Code Elimination
description: Eliminate the NeedsReauth bool flag entirely from the codebase. The flag was introduced as a mechanism to trigger a token refresh before the next API call after a scope change. It was never effective because simply appending scopes locally (without the Zoho incremental auth flow) does not change the issued refresh token. The 401 auto-retry in ApiClient already handles token expiry. Removing NeedsReauth eliminates dead code and prevents misleading output in 'account list' and 'account show'.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–13 complete. AccountEntry, AccountListView, AccountShowView all have NeedsReauth property. AccountService sets NeedsReauth in multiple places. ApiClient has a NeedsReauth pre-refresh block and ClearNeedsReauthAsync helper. Project compiles and all tests pass.
goal: After this story: NeedsReauth does not exist anywhere in the codebase. 'account list' and 'account show' no longer emit a needs_reauth field. ApiClient no longer performs a pre-refresh based on NeedsReauth. The 401 auto-retry path in ApiClient is unchanged and continues to handle token expiry correctly.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountListView.cs: Remove the 'public bool NeedsReauth { get; init; }' property. No other changes.
Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountShowView.cs: Remove the 'public bool NeedsReauth { get; init; }' property. No other changes.
Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountService.cs — ExchangeAndFinalizeAsync: Remove 'NeedsReauth = false' from the AccountEntry initializer block.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountService.cs — ListAccountsAsync: Remove 'NeedsReauth = a.NeedsReauth' from the AccountListView projection. If it is the only member making the with-expression non-trivial, simplify accordingly.
Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountService.cs — ShowAccountAsync: Remove 'NeedsReauth = account.NeedsReauth' from the AccountShowView projection.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountService.cs — AddScopesAsync: Remove 'NeedsReauth = true' from the 'account with { ... }' expression. The with-expression must still set 'Scopes = updatedScopes' — only the NeedsReauth assignment is removed.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Accounts/AccountService.cs — ReAuthAsync: Remove 'NeedsReauth = false' from the .Select() lambda. If the lambda becomes 'a => a.Name == name ? a with { } : a' with no effective change, remove the select transform entirely or simplify to direct array replacement without a with-expression.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Api/ApiClient.cs: Remove the entire NeedsReauth pre-refresh block — the 'if (account.NeedsReauth) { ... }' block including the logger call, the RefreshTokenAsync call, and the ClearNeedsReauthAsync call. All three lines inside the block are deleted; the if-statement itself is also deleted.

Modify src/ZapiCli.Core/Api/ApiClient.cs: Remove the entire private ClearNeedsReauthAsync method — find the 'private async Task ClearNeedsReauthAsync(string accountName, CancellationToken ct)' method and delete it in full.

Update existing unit tests: search test files for any assertion or setup that references NeedsReauth and remove/update those lines. Tests that assert 'NeedsReauth = true' after scope changes, or 'NeedsReauth = false' after re-auth, must be deleted or rewritten to verify the behaviour that actually matters (scope list correctness, token refresh call count, etc.).

Both must be deleted; the surrounding steps (Step 2 ZohoCorp guard, Step 4 URL parsing) must remain. For AccountEntry deserialization: System.Text.Json ignores unknown JSON properties by default when deserializing records, so existing accounts.json files with 'needs_reauth' will deserialize fine — no migration script needed. For test files: run a text search for 'NeedsReauth' across the tests/ directory and handle each occurrence individually.
